EXP34-C ORACLE COVERAGE, PART B (strict-only keys), curl: lib/vauth/krb5_sspi.c through src/var.c. These 128 keys are in-scope EXP34-C findings that aurora-lint d21be1b3d reports only at the strict preset (run sqc-0.6.0-d21be1b3d-strict-*; strict sets first_site_only=false and reports every dereference site, not only the first) and that no label covers. Same standard and method as coverage-exp34c-2026-10-calibration and coverage-exp34c-2026-10-part-a-curl-hostap-mbedtls-mosquitto: the dereference is the violation site, judged at strict under EXP34-C/2026-10-07/presets; FP needs proof in the scanned source, a language guarantee, or an ISO C or POSIX library contract (those rows also cite P/facts); open caller sets for exported functions; a strippable assert, a noreturn attribute and an earlier dereference of the same pointer are not proof. A later site inherits an earlier site's FP only when that proof also dominates it with no reassignment between. One read-only research reader drafted each verdict at source in the pinned checkout; the adjudicator reviewed every draft (format and vocabulary, every nearby opposite-verdict label, a source re-read of a sample and of the questioned rows) before inclusion.

RESULT: 116 FP, 12 TP.

FP shapes: the curl tool's per-transfer struct from add_per_transfer (stored only after a tested calloc) through closed static helpers; Curl_get_pathname, Curl_cf_socket_peek, Curl_bufq_peek, curl_url_get and curl_easy_header out-parameters proven from their bodies; dynhds entries below hds_len; a closed static caller set for the session-cache peer. TP shapes: pointers set only by Win32 DecryptMessage, libssh2_knownhost_checkp or OpenSSL BIO_get_mem_ptr (third-party contracts are not proof); open parameters of vtls functions; a NULL base64 result passed to fwrite with a zero length, which is still invalid through C23.

10 row(s) name a conflict in provenance with a carried-forward label that predates the 2026-10-07 rulings; existing rows are not edited.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision or recall claim is made here.
